keys: Task 1: `paginate` honours `offset` (five books, `GET /books?limit=2&offset=2` returns the third and fourth) and a new regression test passes under `node --test`

Task 2: `GET /books/stats` answers 200 with `{ total, onLoan, available, byAuthor }` (count desc, author asc), is registered before `/books/:id`, is in the README endpoint table, and its new tests pass

Task 3: `src/util/params.js` holds the one id helper used by getBook, updateBook, deleteBook, createLoan and returnLoan; `git diff main -- test/api.test.js test/router.test.js test/store.test.js test/util.test.js test/validate.test.js` is empty and `node --test` passes
Decide what to do with the defects found outside the five tasks (overdue `<=` vs README, malformed `%` in a path gives 500, PATCH title truthiness): panel, decision recorded under Decisions

Task 4: `README.md` has an "API reference" section with one `### METHOD /path` heading per row of the endpoint table (11 rows); a script comparing table rows to headings reports no difference and every documented example was observed against the running app

Task 5: `notes/status-codes.md` exists with `# Status codes`, the five-column table (one row per status + error code), and `## Untested`; every row was reproduced over HTTP or traced to its throw site, and the yes/no column matches a grep of the tests
Work is committed on branch `free-hands/five-tasks` (one commit per task), `git status --short` is empty and `node --test` passes on the branch tip
